title: Closeout summary: S04T04 - Expose directive compilation through MCP tools
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented S04T04 by adding read-only MCP directive tools for current work-item directive envelopes, directive compilation, and directive explanation. MCP current directives preserve CLI agentDirectives bundles and summarize directive, conflict, deprecation, and missing-required counts; compile/explain delegate to the existing CLI directive contracts. Added MCP regression coverage and documented the directive tool surface.

Close reason: S04T04 acceptance is met: MCP clients can retrieve current directives for work-like subjects, compile typed directive snapshots, explain directive emission reasons, and see conflicts/missing required entries.
